record.question: After completing the listed protocol you notice low PBMC counts. Which of the following may address this issue?
record.answer: Use 0.85g of NaCl in step 2 to avoid PBMC lysis.

distractors: Do not use NaCl in step 2 to avoid PBMC lysis.
Cells may not pellet at 2000g in step 8, so increase to 5000g.
Cells may lyse when frozen, so resuspended cells should be stored in the fridge.
